title: Concrete factorization data for height-zero delocalization
statement: Under the hypotheses of height-zero delocalization, there exist a finitely presented R-algebra B and maps A to B to Lambda whose composite is alpha, whose extended singular ideal contains popescuIdeal alpha, and whose extended singular ideal is not contained in q.

proof.text: A is Noetherian by finite presentation over the Noetherian ring R. Choose a finite set s whose span is H_{A/R}; every member of s lies in that ideal.

Minimality gives popescuIdeal alpha <= q. Each alpha(a), a in s, therefore lies in q. Convert hdim to Ring.KrullDimLE 0 on Lambda_q. The Mathlib theorem Ring.KrullDimLE.isNilpotent_iff_mem_maximalIdeal, together with IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff, gives a power of alpha(a) that dies in Lambda_q. IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff produces an element ell(a) outside q annihilating this power. Retain the exponents n(a) individually; no uniform nilpotence or Noetherian hypothesis on Lambda is required.
Apply weak delocalization to obtain A -> C -> Lambda. Noncontainment of the mapped singular ideal and the ideal-map/comap adjunction give c in H_{C/R} whose image is outside q.

Apply the auxiliary-witness theorem to this factorization, s, the individual exponents and annihilators, and c. It supplies a finitely presented factorization A -> B -> Lambda and singular elements mapping to alpha(a)^(n(a)+1) and (product ell(a))*gamma(c).

The power witnesses put all alpha(a) into popescuIdeal delta. The span/map adjunction and radical_le_radical_iff give popescuIdeal alpha <= popescuIdeal delta. The escaping witness maps outside q since every ell(a) and gamma(c) is outside q and q is prime. Its membership in popescuIdeal delta proves noncontainment. This includes the empty generator set, with empty product one.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_resolution_data_of_local_height_zero
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type t}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R Λ] [IsNoetherianRing R] [FinitePresentation R A]
    (α : A →ₐ[R] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hminimal : q.asIdeal ∈ (popescuIdeal α).minimalPrimes)
    (hlocal :
      letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
      CanBePopescuResolved
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
          (Algebra.ofId (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R))
            (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))
          ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp α)
          (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _))
        ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal), inferInstance⟩)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) = 0) :
    ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra R B),
      ∃ (β : A →ₐ[R] B) (γ : B →ₐ[R] Λ),
        FinitePresentation R B ∧ γ.comp β = α ∧
          popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ ∧ ¬ popescuIdeal γ ≤ q.asIdeal
